title: FilterDirect Payments Desk Note: Failed Shipment Charges
content:
For FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions, a charge that fails is retried every 3 days, up to 2 times, after which shipments pause until a card is updated.

| Grade | Days between automatic retries | Retries before shipments pause for non-payment |
|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | 3 | 2 |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | 3 | 2 |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | 3 | 2 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | 3 | 2 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | 3 | 2 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | 3 | 2 |

### Timeline of a charge whose retries also fail (hypothetical month)

| Day | Event |
|---|---|
| 5th | The shipment charge fails on the ship date. |
| 8th | First automatic retry, 3 days later. |
| 11th | Second automatic retry, 3 days after the first. |
| After the second retry | The retries are used up; the subscription's shipments pause until a card is updated. |

### Points of judgement

- **How many attempts in all.** The original charge plus at most 2 retries, so no more than three attempts on one failed charge.
- **Spacing.** Each retry falls 3 days after the attempt before it.
- **What lifts the pause.** A pause for non-payment lasts until a card is updated.
- **Status.** An active subscription whose failed-charge retries have run out shows as paused.
